COVER IT YOUR WAY 📚✂️🎨
A DIY Book Cover Social
Join Soma Book Shop x The Craft Collective for an afternoon of books, collage, creativity, and community.
Bring a favorite book, your current read, or come with an idea for a book of your own. Then reimagine the cover your way on canvas.
While we create, we’ll talk favorite books and genres, swap recommendations, discover new reads, and vibe with fellow book and craft lovers in BIPOC community. 💛
